mechanism.claim: A large signed shift in the median one-minute return from the first half to the second half of a volatile completed BTC block indicates broad directional repricing rather than a few extreme candles. Follow the robust location-shift direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of second-half minus first-half median one-minute return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVIDBR uses an unsigned Kolmogorov-Smirnov supremum over full half-distributions; temporal variance candidates compare second moments; realized skew and kurtosis use full-block higher moments; change-point and fitted classifiers use different operators. HVMRSR uses one fixed signed median-location contrast and no block endpoint, volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must be in its causal upper 35% while the robust signed location shift enters its upper magnitude quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily median-location-shift onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.shift_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(median_shift) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sum squared minute returns, finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no half partition, median, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
